analysis.title: Gaming: What the latest state data tells us about US gaming
key_insights: October same-state OSB handle is tracking flat yoy in data from 14 to 16 states reported so far, versus c.+1% in September, so US sportsbook volume growth remains soft.

October OSB hold is slightly below the LTM average, consistent with Flutter's commentary on unfavourable early-4Q sports results. Hold improved sequentially after a weak September and is up slightly yoy.
FanDuel handle is c.-2% yoy in October versus c.+6% in September, DraftKings c.-3% versus c.-4%, BetMGM c.+4% versus c.-6%, and Fanatics c.+34% (c.+16% ex NY) versus c.+19%.
FanDuel GGR share is tracking c.+2pp yoy and c.+5pp mom in October after September share of c.33% (-7pp yoy). DraftKings is c.-2pp yoy and c.-2pp mom after September share of c.37%.
BetMGM OSB GGR share is c.-1pp yoy in October and Fanatics c.+1pp yoy, both at c.7% in September. Bet365 national GGR share is around 3-5%.
On an NGR basis for Jul-Sep, FanDuel share is c.38%, DraftKings c.31%, and BetMGM and Fanatics c.9% each.

OSB promotional intensity stepped down seasonally in October, and promos as a % of handle are down an average of 0.5pp yoy across states with data. FanDuel, DraftKings and BetMGM promo levels are broadly similar.
iGaming GGR growth re-accelerated to c.+15% yoy in October from c.+12% in September. Pennsylvania Live GGR grew c.+1% yoy versus slots at c.+14%.
iGaming share in October: Flutter c.27% (-1pp yoy), DraftKings c.23% (stable), BetMGM c.19% (-1pp).
The US online market generated GGR of c.$26bn in 2025, with a path to over $40bn by 2028E on GS forecasts. October data covers c.52% of OSB GGR and c.99% of iGaming GGR, so outputs may change.

GS stays Buy on DraftKings (PT $26, cut from $34 in prior Aug note), Entain (PT 800p) and Flutter (PT $120). On Flutter, the stock trades at 7x EV/EBITDA and a 10% FCF yield on lowered 2028 forecasts, and re-rating depends on US OSB product delivery and FanDuel Predicts returns.
Customer perception data from HundredX (NPS and NPI) are tracked for BetMGM, DraftKings, FanDuel, Fanatics, Caesars, ESPN Bet and BetRivers, but the text gives no readings.

market_movers.rationale: Thesis rests on TAM expansion, improving state-cohort unit economics and an Adj. EBITDA and FCF inflection. PT was lowered to $26 on 8 Nov 2026 from $34 on 7 Aug 2026.
Expectations have been reset, with the stock at 7x EV/EBITDA and a 10% FCF yield on lowered 2028 forecasts. The re-rating needs US OSB product delivery and FanDuel Predicts evidence.
Entain (London-listed) is backed by Online momentum and the BetMGM profitability inflection. The PT is 85% fundamental SOTP and 15% M&A valuation.

sector_views.sector: US online sports betting and iGaming
sector_views.rationale: OSB handle is flat yoy and hold is slightly below average, while iGaming GGR is growing c.+15%. Buy ratings are kept on DKNG, FLUT and Entain on valuation.

earnings_insights: October state data is tracking flat OSB handle yoy and slightly below-average hold, consistent with Flutter's commentary on unfavourable early-4Q sports results.
GS expects Flutter 2027 EBITDA meaningfully below the CMD guidance and prior expectations, and sees Group EBITDA growing at a mid-teens rate longer term with US EBITDA doubling over 2027-30E.
risk_factors: Prediction markets are a perceived competitive risk to Flutter and the broader OSB industry.
Continued Fanatics share gains and smaller-operator competition could lift promotional intensity.
Unfavourable sporting results could keep hold below average.
Regulatory and tax developments, including slower legalisation of new states, are a risk for the sector.
State data limitations: October covers only 16 states, GGR is not NGR, and market share covers operator-level data for only 23 states for GGR and 8 for NGR.
Entain-specific risks include a potential AUSTRAC penalty and BetMGM share and profitability trends.

tension_points.bull_case: Expectations are significantly reset and the stock trades at 7x EV/EBITDA with a 10% FCF yield. GS sees Group EBITDA growing mid-teens longer term with US EBITDA doubling over 2027-30E.
tension_points.bear_case: Perceived competitive risk from prediction markets, FanDuel share losses, increased promotional spend and a 2027 EBITDA meaningfully below CMD guidance.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Failure to show an improved US OSB product and investment return and evidence of returns from FanDuel Predicts and market making over the 12-month view.
